111:t_1:89.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn $$フロンタル$$'s dogs... They act like they're my watchdogs...」

111:t_1:90.en:
$$チェーン$$
「Thank you, $$ギュネイ$$. You saved me.」

111:t_1:91.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't be so familiar. I'm a $$ネオ・ジオン$$ soldier now.」

111:t_1:92.en:
$$チェーン$$
「...What are you so irritated about?」

111:t_1:94.en:
$$チェーン$$
「You don't approve of the way $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is doing things now, do you...?」

111:t_1:95.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Shut up...! Now that the Federation is weakened, it's time for the $$スペースノイド$$s' dearest wish to come true!」

111:t_1:96.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'm $$ネオ・ジオン$$...! I'll simply fight for the people of space!」

111:t_1:98.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「...Get the $$νガンダム$$ serviced.」

111:t_1:100.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「The Leader only told me to seize this base and secure the $$ガンダム$$. I'll decide what comes next at my own discretion.」

111:t_1:101.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
(That's right... To surpass that man, I have to defeat the $$ガンダム$$ with my own hands...)

111:t_2:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm glad you're safe, $$チェーン$$.」

111:t_2:7.en:
$$チェーン$$
「Its maintenance is done. On $$ギュネイ$$'s orders, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ hasn't laid a finger on it.」

111:t_2:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「There's still hope for this battle and for $$ネオ・ジオン$$...!」

111:t_3:3.en: ～$$フル・フロンタル$$　Private Quarters～

111:t_3:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...I'm pleased you seem to understand.」

111:t_3:6.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Your collaborators, 《$$クロノ$$》, are already losing their influence.」

111:t_3:7.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「As your new collaborator, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ will prove itself by reaching $$クロノ$$'s doctrine through its own efforts.」

111:t_3:8.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I understand. I'll report this matter to Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$.」

111:t_3:10.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$ラプラスの箱$$... So you will give me the power to change the world after all.」

111:t_3:12.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Captain $$アンジェロ$$... What's the situation on Earth?」

111:t_3:13.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Due to $$ギュネイ・ガス$$'s blunder, $c has retaken $$ピーターソン基地$$.」

111:t_3:14.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then that $$ガンダム$$ is...」

111:t_3:15.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「It is in $$アムロ・レイ$$'s hands.」

111:t_3:17.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Did you anticipate this outcome?」

111:t_3:18.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I merely considered either outcome acceptable. If the $$ガンダム$$ fell into $$アムロ・レイ$$'s hands, I would question $$ギュネイ$$'s ability as a commander...」

111:t_3:19.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「And if he held the $$ガンダム$$ and the base, that would be welcome in its own right.」

111:t_3:20.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I feel that man doesn't understand who $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s current leader is.」

111:t_3:21.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's only been a short time since I became the Leader. It cannot be helped.」

111:t_3:22.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s supporters, including him, are valuable forces for $$ネオ・ジオン$$. We need them to understand, however long it takes.」

111:t_3:23.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Then $$ギュネイ・ガス$$ will...」

111:t_3:24.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「There's no need to write him off over a single failure. I'll have him work for us too.」

111:t_3:25.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「From now on, we'll pursue the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ while driving out the $$連邦軍$$ in North America.」

111:t_3:26.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You're after $$ラプラスの箱$$...」

111:t_3:27.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Yes. During the $$時獄戦役$$, the coordinates after $$ダカール$$ were revealed, but $$バナージ$$ apparently has no intention of going there.」

111:t_3:28.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then we have no choice but to carry the key to the Box there ourselves.」

111:t_3:29.en:
$$フロンタル$$
(That's how it is, $$バナージ$$. I'm sorry, but we too are running out of time.)

111:t_3:30.en:
$$フロンタル$$
(At this rate, Earth's humanity will perish... I will use every means at my disposal to preserve the human species...)

111:t_3:37.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「It seems a lot of our members are in shock.」

111:t_3:38.en:
$$マリー$$
「It's understandable. We expected it from $$ネオ・ジオン$$, but to think even part of the $$連邦軍$$ was cooperating with the Empire...」

111:t_3:39.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So neither $$ピーターソン基地$$ falling so easily nor $$ジオン$$ coming to the base with the $$νガンダム$$ was a coincidence.」

111:t_3:40.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「The collaborators inside the $$連邦軍$$ arranged it all.」

111:t_3:41.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「According to Warrant Officer $$チェーン$$, bringing the $$νガンダム$$ here was itself a scheme by the pro-$$サイデリアル$$ faction within the $$連邦軍$$.」

111:t_3:42.en:
$$刹那$$
「And they invited $$ネオ・ジオン$$ in, putting up only token resistance before handing over the base...」

111:t_3:43.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Are you saying they abandoned the $$連邦軍$$ because they looked likely to lose to the Empire!?」

111:t_3:45.en:
$$アムロ$$
「They're probably... forces under $$クロノ$$'s influence.」

111:t_3:47.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$クロノ$$ collaborated with $$ジェミニス$$... So they're in league with $$サイデリアル$$ too.」

111:t_3:48.en:
$n
「If we'd crushed them during the $$時獄戦役$$, this wouldn't have happened...」

111:t_3:49.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If the fighting continues like this...」

111:t_3:50.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$クロノ$$ will tear the $$連邦軍$$ apart from within, and they'll lose all command and control.」

111:t_3:52.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The $$連邦軍$$' defeat will be inevitable.」

111:t_3:53.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The remaining forces in each region will keep fighting, but it'll be hard to reverse the tide. More than that, people's spirits will break before then...」

111:t_3:54.en:
$$アムロ$$
「At worst, those who keep resisting $$サイデリアル$$ may become a minority among humanity...」

111:t_3:55.en:
$$刹那$$
「But the peace gained by submitting to the Empire like that is false.」

111:t_3:56.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right. That shouldn't be the future we sought when we destroyed the $$時の牢獄$$.」

111:t_3:57.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I... think there's still hope.」

111:t_3:59.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「He was in $$ネオ・ジオン$$, but he was growing increasingly irritated with its methods.」

111:t_3:60.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「He can't be the only one who feels that way.」

111:t_3:61.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I agree. During the $$時獄戦役$$, people chose to overcome hardship and seek a future.」

111:t_3:62.en:
$$アムロ$$
「As long as you understand that, it's fine.」

111:t_3:63.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You know what we need to do in all this, don't you?」

111:t_3:64.en:
$n
「We must keep fighting... And by doing so, we must become a source of hope for the people fighting the Empire.」
